---
title: "ISOE School"
subtitle: "Blood-center IT, regulation, and IS governance, built for one learner"
toc: false
---

Personal courses built with Claude. Each course starts with a **finish line**, something
concrete you'll be able to do, and works backward to the fundamentals.

**How to use it:** open a course from the sidebar, start at its syllabus, and go
module by module. Every lesson follows the same order: scenario, why the rule exists,
the rule in plain English, the actual text, the evidence an inspector would ask for,
common traps, and a self-check. Tap a collapsed box to reveal an answer.

**Foundations** are shared building blocks, like reading a CFR citation. They're taught
once and linked wherever a course needs them.

*Public regulatory material only. Scenarios use the fictional Lakeshore Blood Center.*
